This plot no be my own, na rent I rent am, so I no fit spend too much money on fertilizer wey go fat the soil for landlord. But maize no dey grow well for this our South West ground without small fertilizer, so I go buy one bag NPK and share am small small. I go plant the local maize seed wey I save from last season, and I go join am with cassava and small vegetable. For labor, na me and my family go do most of the work, but I go call two-three men for clearing and ridging.
